name: rotator cuff stretch
description: A stretch aimed at the small stabilizing muscles around the shoulder joint.
instructions: Stand tall and bring one arm across your body at chest height.
Hold the arm just above the elbow with the other hand and draw it in until the back of the shoulder stretches.
Keep the shoulder blade down and relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
